Not checking the plumb line regularly.

options: They were new to the task.

activity_c.text: Haran and Latha walked up to Mr. Suresh after the morning safety briefing.
Both looked uneasy, and Haran began the conversation.
Good morning, Sir, we need to speak with you.
We realised we made a few mistakes last week, and we want to explain them properly.
Vanakkam, both of you. Thank you for coming to me directly.
Let’s go through them one by one.
Haran, tell me then , what happened?
I marked the wall line incorrectly.
Where exactly were you when your problem occurred?
I was near the scaffolding tower, right beside the cement-mixing area.
And when did it happen? What time was it?
It was Monday, around a quarter past ten, just before the measurement check.
Alright. Now tell me—how did you end up marking the wall line incorrectly?
Sir… I pulled the chalk reel too fast.
I should have checked the level first, but I didn’t.
I usually check it, but not every single day—maybe three times a week.
And why didn’t you check it that morning?
Honestly, sir, I thought the level was still accurate from the previous day.
But now I know I shouldn’t assume that.
Good. So how will you prevent this from happening again?
I’m going to check the spirit level every morning and record it in the logbook.
I’ll also slow down when marking long lines.
Alright. Now Latha, tell me what was your mistake?
I was laying bricks and they ended up misaligned.
Where were you when your mistake happened?
I was near the bricklaying section, right beside the wheelbarrow rack.
And when was that?
Thursday around 1.30 p.m., during the block-work session.
And how did your blocks end up misaligned?
Sir, I set the line wire correctly, but I placed the blocks too quickly and didn’t check the plumb each time.
I also used the older trowel, and the mortar spread unevenly.
Why didn’t you check the plumb line regularly?
I was rushing, sir.
I check it most of the time, but that day I tried to finish the row fast because the next batch of blocks was arriving.
So how will you avoid these issues next time?
I’m going to follow the block-laying sequence properly, check the plumb after each block, and use the newer trowel.
I’ll also slow down and focus on accuracy.
Good. These are small mistakes, not big failures, but they matter.
Let’s aim for consistency this week.
